correctness.rationale: The proof correctly reduces radial maximization to the spectral interval of the rank-two compression P_A|_L. For t=4/s^2>1/2 the event D<=s requires either lambda_- >=t or lambda_+<=1-t, disjoint equal-probability events. The SO(4) self-dual/anti-self-dual oriented-Grassmannian coordinates U=p12+p34 and V=p12-p34 are independent uniform[-1,1]; compressed signed eigenvalues are UV +/- sqrt((1-U^2)(1-V^2)). Same-sign angular variables convert the event into a+b<=alpha with Jacobian sin(a)sin(b)/4; elementary integration gives the stated CDF. The endpoint atom is P(U^2+V^2<=1)=pi/4, and expansion gives the lower quadratic tail. Independent finite difference derivative checks at five interior points and the exact endpoint normalization passed; these do not establish the Haar parametrization, which is proved separately.
